strings.frame.layers.tip: Click to select; drag up or down to change the stacking order. Ctrl+Up and Ctrl+Down also move it
strings.frame.mode.tip: Place: drag to move, and drag corners or edges to resize. Crop: drag edges to cut the video
strings.frame.flip.tip: Mirrors the video left to right
strings.frame.allow-outside.tip: Lets the video move beyond the stream screen
strings.frame.crop-mode.tip: Drag the edges to cut the video
strings.frame.reset-crop.tip: Stops cropping and zooming, and shows the whole video
strings.frame.fit.tip: Makes the video as large as fits on the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.fill.tip: Makes the video cover the stream screen, keeping its aspect ratio
strings.frame.center.tip: Moves the video to the center of the stream screen without resizing it
strings.frame.forward.tip: Swaps places with the video just in front
strings.frame.backward.tip: Swaps places with the video just behind
strings.frame.front.tip: Shows the video in front of the others
strings.frame.back.tip: Shows the video behind the others
strings.error.unexpected: Something went wrong and the action could not be completed. Please try again.
strings.preview.label: Stream preview
strings.preview.frame-rate.tip: Stream frame rate. Below the set rate the video looks choppy
strings.preview.exit-fullscreen: Leaves full screen and returns to the normal view
strings.preview.fullscreen-hint: Press Esc or F to return
strings.notice.failure.title: Couldn't complete the action
strings.startup.data-root.title: Can't use the data folder
strings.startup.data-root.body: Virtual Vessel Studio can't write to the data folder. Check the folder location and free space, then start again.
strings.startup.failed.title: Virtual Vessel Studio couldn't start
strings.startup.failed.body: Start it again. If this keeps happening, report it with the logs.
strings.settings.recovered.title: Couldn't read the settings file
strings.settings.recovered.body: Started with the default settings. The original file is kept in the same folder.
strings.settings.save-failed.title: Couldn't save the settings
strings.settings.save-failed.body: Your changes apply until you quit. Check that the settings folder can be written to.
strings.tip.nav.setup: Set up avatars and devices before you stream
strings.tip.nav.diagnostics: Inspect how things are running (for developers)
strings.screen.placeholder: This screen is on its way
strings.settings.title: App settings
strings.settings.motion.description: Stops movement and blinking on screen. With Match Windows settings, they stop when Animation effects is off in Windows.
strings.diagnostics.detailed-off: Detailed metrics: off. Times and values are not recorded
strings.diagnostics.column.name: Name
strings.tip.nav.gallery: Check how the shared parts look and work (for developers)
strings.gallery.note: These are samples: using them changes no setting or state
strings.gallery.disabled-reason: Connect a camera to use this
strings.gallery.tooltip-note: Shows after about half a second, and when chosen with the keyboard. It says briefly what a control does, with its shortcut, and why a disabled button can't be used
strings.tip.gallery.sample: Says briefly what a control does
strings.tip.gallery.mic: Turn the microphone on or off
strings.gallery.title: Stream title
strings.gallery.notice-body: It is here to check how notices look
strings.gallery.dialog-body: This is a sample; nothing changes
strings.live.hint: Drag a video to move it and drag its corners to resize it. Right-click for more.
strings.setup.capture.game.title: Capture (game screen)
strings.setup.capture.subscreen.title: Capture (sub monitor)
strings.setup.capture.problem.choose: Choose the capture board under Device. A camera is never opened by itself, so a webcam does not show you by mistake.
strings.setup.capture.problem.signal: No video is arriving. Check the game device's power and cable.
strings.setup.capture.problem.notfound: It is found again by itself when connected.
strings.setup.capture.problem.failed: Another app may be using the device.
strings.setup.capture.problem.inuse: Tracking uses this camera. Choose another device.
strings.setup.tracking.title: Tracking
strings.setup.tracking.problem.choose: Choose the webcam to track with in Camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.notfound: The camera is not found. It is found again when you connect it.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.inuse: The game screen capture uses this camera. Choose another camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.failed: The camera could not open or tracking could not start. Check that no other app is using the camera.
strings.setup.tracking.problem.noperson: Sit in front of the camera so your face and upper body are in view.
